rrna_operon_count_design_read_for_growth.verdict: false refusal by the registry's own evidence
rrna_operon_count_design_read_for_growth.why: the record is about WHICH operon was deleted (the variant reassigns every rRNA row to the mean over all seven, erasing identity but keeping the total), so a count-level reading is represented; A-1's positive control reproduces it. The rule that refuses it maps the whole design family to the operon-specific record and already refused the same reads through `design` and `target`; P-2 made it consistent. Narrowing it is decision Y11.

growth_law_fit_including_condition_no_gl.why: the no-carbon record: growth continues with no carbon uptake, so the point means nothing; the refusal now names the design so the fit can run without it
